content.text: : in children given ASA after a viral infect
(flapping tremor of the hand w/ wrist ext), hyperreflexia, cerebral edema, ↑ICP
: ↑PT, INR (≥1.5); eventually ↑PTT ← ↓hepatic prod of coag factors
Hepatomeg, jaundice (⍉USU seen in Reye syndrome)
: may develop rash (hands/ft), intractable vomiting, liver damage, encephalopathy, dilated pupils w/ minimal response to light, multi-organ failure
Sxs + hepatic encephalopathy + abnorm LFTs + INR ≥1.5
: IVF, lyte repletion, mannitol if ICP elevation, PPI stress ulcer prophylaxis
Idiopathic chronic inflam of the liver ← circulating autoantibodies
: cirrhosis, pericarditis, myocarditis, proliferative glomerulonephritis, uveitis
, nonspecific sxs (fatigue, nausea, malaise, abd pain, arthralgia)
: may be norm; hepatomeg, splenomegaly, jaundice
Liver bx: definitive dx – bridging necrosis or multiacinar necrosis
Can progress to cirrhosis or hepatic failure if EToH use continues
– steatosis, neutrophil or lymphocyte infiltration, Mallory-Denk bodies, cholestasis
